the neurocognitive underpinnings of ToM in aging, and the role of age-related changes in cognition on ToM.
the impact of aging on ToM and its cognitive and affectative components, which are mediated by distinct cognitive processes and rely on partly different neural substrates.
the neurocognitive determinants and substrates of ToM in healthy aging, with the aim to better understand its decline in the elderly.
